title: Lurking-Variable Reversal Detector
description: Paste your own stratified 2x2 table (any number of strata, custom group/outcome/stratum labels) to get per-stratum odds ratios, the crude pooled odds ratio, the Mantel-Haenszel (1959) adjusted odds ratio, and an explicit reversal flag when the aggregate and stratified stories disagree. The Berkeley 1973 six-department admissions table (Bickel, Hammel & O'Connell 1975, Science 187:398-404) ships built in as the worked example.
data_vintage: Built-in worked example is a static 1973 historical dataset (Bickel, Hammel & O'Connell 1975, Science 187:398-404), never refreshed. Primary use is a user-pasted table; the tool holds no live or refreshable data.
regulatory_citations: Bickel, P.J., Hammel, E.A., O'Connell, J.W. (1975). "Sex Bias in Graduate Admissions: Data from Berkeley." Science 187(4175):398-404.
Mantel, N., Haenszel, W. (1959). "Statistical Aspects of the Analysis of Data from Retrospective Studies of Disease." Journal of the National Cancer Institute 22(4):719-748.

mcp_tool_definition.name: lurking_variable_reversal_detector
mcp_tool_definition.description: Compute per-stratum odds ratios, a crude pooled odds ratio, and a Mantel-Haenszel pooled odds ratio from a user-supplied stratified 2x2 table, flagging Simpson's-paradox-style reversal when the crude and adjusted estimates disagree in direction.
